title: Mother, Child and White Pet Dog on Lawn - Antique 1920s Sepia Snapshot Photo
description: A charming 1920s backyard snapshot featuring a smiling young woman with a classic bob hairstyle crouching on the grass next to a standing toddler and an alert white pet dog. They are positioned in front of the brick foundation and wooden lap siding of a suburban American home. The image exemplifies early 20th-century domestic life and vernacular family photography.
